query: Equal-atomic NbMoTaW is a single-phase BCC refractory high-entropy alloy with excellent mechanical properties at 1600 °C but very poor room-temperature ductility, while its irradiation resistance has primarily been proposed by first-principles calculations. What intervention could improve its room-temperature ductility without compromising its high-temperature mechanical performance or irradiation resistance? State one hypothesis that identifies the intervention and mechanism, predicts outcomes relative to the untreated NbMoTaW baseline under room-temperature, 1600 °C, and irradiation assessments, defines its boundary conditions, cites supporting prior evidence, and proposes a falsification experiment.

generation.hypothesis: The introduction of 1 at.% boron through spark plasma sintering improves room-temperature ductility by 20%, maintains high-temperature mechanical performance at 1600 °C, and preserves irradiation resistance as predicted by first-principles calculations.
generation.intervention: Introduction of 1 at.% boron through spark plasma sintering
generation.conditions: Sintering at 1800 °C for 30 minutes under 50 MPa pressure, followed by water quenching
generation.structural_mediator: Formation of boron-rich grain boundary phases
generation.mechanism: Boron segregation to grain boundaries, reducing grain boundary energy and enhancing dislocation mobility, thus improving room-temperature ductility without compromising high-temperature strength or irradiation resistance
generation.predicted_outcome: Improved room-temperature ductility by 20%, maintained high-temperature mechanical performance at 1600 °C, and preserved irradiation resistance as predicted by first-principles calculations
generation.boundary: The introduction of boron should not compromise the high-temperature mechanical performance or irradiation resistance of the alloy
generation.uncertainty: The effect of boron on irradiation resistance is not well-established and requires additional experiments to verify

falsification_experiment.design: Conduct additional experiments to verify the effect of boron on irradiation resistance and adjust the boron content accordingly
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the introduction of boron compromises the irradiation resistance or high-temperature mechanical performance of the alloy, the hypothesis is falsified
